description: Implementation of logging functionalities for the starboard platform, including log level management, stack trace generation, and log message formatting.

classes.name: Stack
classes.description: Represents a call stack for debugging purposes.

classes.name: LogMessage
classes.description: Handles creation and output of log messages, including stack traces for fatal logs.

classes.name: LogMessageVoidify
classes.description: Helper class to suppress log message output in certain conditions.

methods.name: SetMinLogLevel
methods.description: Sets the minimum log level for logging output.

methods.name: GetMinLogLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the current minimum log level.

methods.name: StringToLogLevel
methods.description: Converts a string representation of log level to enum.

methods.name: Break
methods.description: Triggers a debugger break if available.

methods.name: Stack::Stack
methods.description: Constructor for capturing a call stack with optional frame skipping.

methods.name: operator<< (const Stack&)
methods.description: Outputs the call stack symbols and addresses.

methods.name: operator<< (const wchar_t*)
methods.description: Outputs a wide-character string as ASCII.

methods.name: LogMessage::LogMessage
methods.description: Initializes a log message with file, line, and priority.

methods.name: LogMessage::~LogMessage
methods.description: Outputs the log message and stack trace if fatal, then triggers debugger break.

methods.name: LogMessage::stream
methods.description: Returns the output stream for the log message.

methods.name: LogMessage::Init
methods.description: Initializes the log message with timestamp, thread info, and message prefix.

methods.name: LogMessageVoidify::operator&
methods.description: Operator to suppress log message output.
